info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Product Management Product Directorys-spec
info.description: The Product Directory Retrieval API allows clients to access a comprehensive list of products available in the banking product management system. It serves as a vital resource for financial institutions and partners seeking to view and understand the various products offered. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their decision-making and streamline their customer service processes by providing accurate product information. Typical consumers include developers integrating banking services, product managers, and customer service representatives.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of products in the directory.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all products available in the product directory. Useful for displaying product information or integrating with other services that require product data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the product directory, which includes a list of products with their respective details and attributes. Ensure that the request is properly formatted as specified to receive the desired output.
